issues.description: The Person model's field visibility differs between artifacts: the problem statement's UML and the template define Person fields as private (encapsulated), while the solution's Person class declares the fields as public. This contradicts the intended encapsulation shown in the UML and in the template and may confuse students about the intended visibility/encapsulation of model fields.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution's Person class consistent with the template and UML by changing the field declarations to private (keep the existing getters/setters). Alternatively, if public fields are intentional, update the problem statement UML and the template to reflect public fields and explain the design choice to students. The preferred fix is to restore private fields in the solution to preserve encapsulation and match the exercise description.
